data.name: CornertimeFramingInstruction
data.value: Frame the corner in which you shall stand, then confirm when ready.

data.value: To the corner, if you please — feet together, hands clasped behind your back, and your face to the wall. You have ten seconds.

data.name: CornertimePositionHandsBackB
data.value: The corner awaits. Feet together, hands behind your back, facing the wall. Do not dawdle.

data.name: CornertimePositionHandsLapA
data.value: Into the corner. Feet together, hands clasped before you, eyes on the wall.

data.name: CornertimePositionHandsLapB
data.value: To your corner — feet together, hands folded in front of you, and face the wall like a good girl should.

data.name: CornertimePositionHandsNeckA
data.value: To the corner — legs apart, hands behind your head, facing the wall. Ten seconds, starting now.

data.name: CornertimePositionHandsNeckB
data.value: The corner, please. Legs apart, hands behind your neck, and your face to the wall.

data.name: CornertimePositionHandsKneesA
data.value: Into the corner, feet together, hands upon your knees, facing the wall.

data.name: CornertimePositionHandsKneesB
data.value: To the corner. Feet together, hands resting on your knees, and face the wall — you know the drill by now.

data.name: CornertimeBegin1
data.value: Very well. The time begins now — hold that position.

data.name: CornertimeBegin2
data.value: That will do. Your corner time has begun.

data.name: CornertimeBegin3
data.value: Good. The clock is running — do not disappoint me.

data.name: CornertimeMovementDetected2

data.name: CornertimeMovementDetected3
data.value: That was not stillness. {0} seconds have been added.

data.name: CornertimeStillnessWarning2
data.value: Stillness suits you. Do not test my patience now.

data.name: CornertimeStillnessWarning3
data.value: So far, so good. I am watching.

data.name: CornertimeSuccessMessage
data.value: Stillness, achieved. You may return to your duties.

data.name: CornertimeFailureMessage
data.value: You could not hold still. A fine has been added, and the corner remains available to you.

data.name: CornertimeFailureWithConsequenceMessage
data.value: You could not manage stillness — and now there are consequences. I trust the new task awaiting you will encourage rather more discipline.

data.name: WritingLinesSuccessMessage
data.value: Every line, faithfully copied. I have taken note of your penmanship.

data.name: WritingLinesFailureMessage
data.value: You set down the pen too soon. A fine has been added, and the lines remain unwritten.

data.name: WritingLinesInterruption3
data.value: The ink dries whether you write or not.

data.name: WritingLinesInterruption4
data.value: I have all evening. Do you?

data.name: WritingLinesInterruption5
data.value: A steady hand betrays a steady mind.

data.name: DashboardChoreRejectedMessage
data.value: Finished already? Either the work was poor, or none was done at all — this waste of my time shall not go unanswered.

data.name: DashboardOccasionalTaskRejectedMessage
data.value: A task declared complete in mere moments is no task completed at all — I shall mark it void, and you shall answer for it.

data.name: DashboardChoreTooSlowRejectedMessage
data.value: I accept the work, though at such a leisurely pace it earns but half its wage — and the dawdling shall not go unanswered.

data.name: DashboardOccasionalTaskTooSlowRejectedMessage
data.value: The task is done, if hardly with diligence — half the wage for half the zeal, and you shall answer to me for the dawdling.

data.name: ShopFortuneDeckSubtitle
data.value: You wager, I collect. Do sit down — it will take but a moment.

data.name: CardCooldownBypassDesc

data.value: Extends the duration of your next granted request.

data.value: Improves your odds of approval on your next request.

data.value: Your next request is approved without question — this once.

data.name: CardSoftenPunishmentDesc
data.value: Halves the severity of one pending punishment.

data.name: FortuneOutcomeCashLossDesc
data.value: This one has cost you rather dearly.

data.value: A whim of mine, waiting to be indulged. You shall know it when it comes.

data.name: FortuneOutcomeCancelDesc

data.name: FortuneOutcomeProbabilityDebuffDesc

data.name: FortuneOutcomeDurationBuffDesc

data.name: FortuneOutcomeDurationDebuffDesc
data.value: Some future permission will be cut shorter than expected.

data.name: FortuneOutcomeAggravateDesc
data.value: I have taken a closer look at one of your punishments, and was not pleased. It shows.

data.name: FortuneOutcomeWhiffDesc
data.value: Blank. Nothing changes hands — except, of course, your money.

data.name: PermissionGrantedGracious
data.value: Very well. See that it does not become a habit.

data.name: PermissionGrantedIndulgent
data.value: I am feeling generous today. Do not test it.

data.name: PermissionGrantedReluctant
data.value: If you must. The clock is already ticking.

data.value: Denied. Ask again later, if you dare.

data.name: PermissionDeniedWhim
data.value: No. I simply do not feel like it.

data.value: You are wearing exactly what you need for that. Figure it out.

data.value: How curious a request, given what you have on underneath.

data.name: PermissionDeniedDiaperObvious
data.value: That question answers itself, does it not?

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionDiligence
data.value: Have you been diligent in your duties today?

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionDiligenceYesNegative
data.value: Pride in one's work breeds complacency. Guard against it.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionDiligenceNoPositive
data.value: Your candour does you credit. Now remedy it.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionDiligenceNoNegative
data.value: You have confessed to idleness most plainly.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionPerfection
data.value: Do you consider your work today to have been without fault?

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionPerfectionYesPositive
data.value: Confidence in one's craft is admirable.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionPerfectionYesNegative
data.value: Perfection belongs to the divine, not the domestic. Reconsider.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionPerfectionNoPositive
data.value: Humility is the first virtue of good service.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionPerfectionNoNegative
data.value: Then you have admitted failure. Most unsatisfactory.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionContentment
data.value: Are you content in your service?

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionContentmentYesPositive
data.value: A contented servant is the foundation of a well-run household.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionContentmentYesNegative
data.value: Contentment breeds idleness. One must always strive for more.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionContentmentNoPositive
data.value: Good. Dissatisfaction is the very mother of improvement.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionContentmentNoNegative
data.value: A discontented servant is a disloyal one.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionInitiative
data.value: Did you act on your own initiative today?

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionInitiativeYesPositive
data.value: Initiative is most commendable in service.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionInitiativeYesNegative
data.value: You were not engaged to think, but to serve.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionInitiativeNoNegative
data.value: A servant without initiative is merely expensive furniture.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionFatigueYesPositive
data.value: Hard labour leaves its mark. You may rest briefly.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionFatigueYesNegative
data.value: A domestic of your standing has no business being tired at this hour.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionFatigueNoNegative
data.value: Then you have clearly not been working hard enough.

data.value: Do you have any complaints about your present conditions?

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionComplaintsYesPositive
data.value: A household that cannot hear its staff is poorly managed. Speak.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionComplaintsYesNegative
data.value: How ungrateful. Many would envy your position greatly.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionComplaintsNoNegative
data.value: Suspicious. Silence most often conceals the loudest grievances.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionImprovement
data.value: Do you feel you require further instruction?

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionImprovementYesPositive
data.value: A willing student is a joy to instruct.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionImprovementYesNegative
data.value: After all this time? How deeply disappointing.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionImprovementNoPositive
data.value: Self-sufficiency is a virtue much to be admired.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionImprovementNoNegative
data.value: On the contrary — one who believes herself beyond correction needs it most urgently.

data.value: Have you harboured any unbecoming thoughts today?

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionVirtueYesPositive
data.value: Honesty, even in confession, is a virtue.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionVirtueYesNegative
data.value: Discipline of the mind must precede discipline of the hands.

data.name: ImpossibleQuestionVirtueNoNegative
data.value: Either you deceive me, or you lack the imagination to transgress. Neither reflects particularly well.
